text:
Ravi (partnerships): Heads upwe've got a joint data-platform demo with Snowflake + Databricks + Milvus on Wed. Need to align on test data, embargo timing, and the marketplace tile content.
Jules (eng): Wed staging slot ok. pls confirm sample sizes and whether we run quantized model or fp16. quant helps cost numbers.
Clara (pm): partner prefers fp16 for fidelity in screenshots, but we can run short quantized pass for cost bench. legal wants 48h review before public.
Eli (field-eng): tech checklist: 1) delta ingest pipeline -> snowflake stage -> databricks transform -> vector upsert to milvus; 2) vector search perf dashboard; 3) fallback plan if QPS spikes. I'll paste run commands.
Ravi (partnerships): @Partner Bot can partner provide someone for a dry run? Also need partner logo, brand guidelines, and preferred quote.
Partner Bot: Partner reply: "Can assign a CSE for Tue afternoon dry run. Logo and quote by Tue 11:00 PT." :white_check_mark:
Jules (eng): demo run snippet: ```bash
# one-liner to populate staging
python ingest.py --source sample_news.ndjson --to snowflake --batch 500 --concurrency 6
# transform job on databricks
dbcli jobs run-now --job-id 4123 --notebook-params '{"sample":"/mnt/sample"}'
# upsert to milvus
./milvus_upsert --collection redwood_demo --file vectors.parquet --shards 4
```
Clara (pm): Ops notes: keep ingest throttled to avoid rate limits on partner side. Add --concurrency flag in runbook. Also draft of marketplace tile copy will be in the shared drive by EOD.
Eli (field-eng): perf note: on 8xA10G perf cluster, p50 140ms for 1k token queries w/ batcher=adaptive. Need p95 and memory profile for the PR.
Jules (eng): I'll attach a short ops doc about KV cache warmup and expected tail during cold starts. Also will run quantized pass overnight and post numbers.
Ravi (partnerships): embargo proposal: demo Wed, partner preview Thu morning, embargo lift Mon 09:00 PT. Is that comfortable?
Clara (pm): that gives legal enough time if we hand them draft by Sat EOD. partner ok with Monday?
Partner Bot: Partner: "Monday 09:00 PT works. We'll send brand assets Tue 11:00 PT"
Eli (field-eng): I'll create the staging runbook at repos/demo/runbooks/multi-platform and share the link after dry run. Will include test checklist: data size, vector dims, per-shard QPS.
Jules (eng): tiny risk: the databricks job can timeout on first run if driver memory not tuned. set DRIVER_MEMORY=32G in the notebook cluster config for demo.
Clara (pm): action items: (1) Eli -> dry run Tue 14:00 PT + post soak logs; (2) Jules -> p50/p95 table + memory profile; (3) Ravi -> collect partner assets + schedule partner dry run; (4) Clara -> draft PR text and send to legal Sat.
Ravi (partnerships): scheduling invite for final sync Mon 10:00 PT. I'll include partner PR and legal. :calendar:
Jules (eng): noted. will reduce ingest concurrency to 4 for demo to keep CPU stable.
Clara (pm): thanks team. linking runbook after Tue soak.
Partner Bot: Reminder set: dry run Tue 14:00 PT.
